| description = Summons your target's corpse to you. Consumes a [[Jade Inlaid Coffin]] when cast. The coffin costs 207 plat with 86 charisma. IMPORTANT: The target must be a group member. If not cast on a group member, the coffin will be consumed to no effect.

This spell was introduced December 1999 [https://wiki.project1999.com/Patch_notes#December_7.2C_1999_Brad.27s_post]
